name: UI/UX Pro Max
description: Comprehensive design guide for web and mobile applications. Contains 67 styles, 96 color palettes, 57 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, and 25 chart types across 13 technology stacks.

name: Frontend Design
description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping existing ones. Focuses on aesthetic direction, typography, layout, motion, and avoiding templated defaults.

name: UX Designer
description: Expert UX design assistance for user research, wireframing, prototyping, design strategy, user flows, personas, usability testing, and information architecture.

name: shadcn/ui
description: Component design system based on shadcn/ui patterns. Includes Radix UI primitives, Tailwind CSS theming, accessible components, and CLI-based workflow.

name: Impeccable
description: Production-grade frontend interface design. Covers color (OKLCH), typography, responsive layout, motion, accessibility, and anti-pattern detection with AI slop prevention.
